title: COSMIC Tech Document
description: Technical breakdown artifact migrated from cosmic-claude assets/schemas/tech.json; metadata and the manual-tracking `revised` flag dropped (no manual-editing UX in docwright), desiredCfps added as the chain anchor copied from the upstream func artifact.

index.description: 1-based position of this function in the upstream plan functions array; must equal the upstream func artifact's index

desiredCfps.description: CFP budget copied from the upstream func artifact's desiredCfps; the total subprocess count is validated against it

diagrams.description: Full mermaid diagram source strings (sequence diagrams of data movements)

processes.description: Functional processes refined for data movement; must cover every process of the upstream func artifact by name

name.description: Process name, unique within the document; kept identical to the upstream func process it refines

subProcesses.description: Data movements of this process in execution order; 3-4 per process is the healthy range, 1/2 and >6 are rejected

description.description: What data moves in this subprocess

dataGroup.description: The data group this movement works on

dataProperties.description: Data properties carried by this movement (at least 2 recommended)

cfp.description: COSMIC function points; always 1 per subprocess
